name: The Grand Pine Hotel
tagline: Mountain tranquility and refined pine valley comfort
description: Nestled high in the misty pine ridge, The Grand Pine Hotel offers serene mountain escapes with all-weather heating, locally sourced dining, and unhurried walking trails.

rooms.name: Deluxe Pine View
rooms.description: Spacious room overlooking the valley with king bed and balcony.

rooms.name: Valley Family Suite
rooms.description: Two connected suites ideal for families traveling together.

gallery.alt: The Grand Pine Hotel facade in morning mist
Cedar dining hall and valley terrace
Pine forest view and surrounding mountain ridge

houseRules: Check-in with valid government photo ID
Quiet hours from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM
Outside visitors permitted in public lounge areas only

faqs.question: Is parking available on site?
faqs.answer: Yes, complimentary on-site private parking is available for all registered guests.

faqs.question: Do you provide heaters in winters?
faqs.answer: Yes, all rooms are equipped with heating facilities during the winter season.

faqs.question: What time is breakfast served?
faqs.answer: Buffet breakfast is served in the cedar dining hall from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM daily.

reviews.author: Ananya Sharma
reviews.text: Splendid views of the cedar hills and incredibly courteous hospitality.
